name: Cost Estimates
excerpt: Cost Estimates involve predicting the financial resources needed for a project.
notes: Cost Estimates include analogous estimates (comparison with similar projects), bottom-up estimates (summing individual activity costs), and parametric modeling (based on material costs). These estimates contribute to cost budgeting and creating a cost baseline.
context_summary: - Involve predicting financial resources needed for a project.
- Include analogous estimates, bottom-up estimates, and parametric modeling.
